Definition: from G4253 and G2476; to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise:--maintain, be over, rule.
BiblicalUsage: Proistemi means to stand before, to preside, to rule, to be over. Paul says he that ruleth must rule with diligence, and tells the Thessalonians to know them which labour among you and are over you in the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that ruling in the church is labour, not lordship, and diligence is the mark of the one who stands before.
